_about: 7 Nov 2026 (0.4.0 re-release): the nav map rebuilt (docs MAP_PLAN.md Phase 1, P2, the owner's notes). The map's pad bindings as built (the D-pad walks destinations and opens the cards, RS moves the map, LS / RS click find me / Sirius), the prompts of the map's pad state, and the map_touchpad row.

rows.label: Touchpad on the nav map
rows.help: On a pad with a touchpad (DualSense, DualShock 4): one finger drags the nav map, two fingers sliding zoom it toward the cursor. Off leaves the right stick and the triggers, which do the same.
